IsDistribute.description:
Indicates how data from the current widget is distributed when it has multiple downstream widgets:  
true – Data from the current widget is round-robin distributed to all downstream widgets. For example, if the current widget has 100 data records and there are two downstream widgets, each downstream widget receives 50 records. The default value is true.  
false – All data from the current widget is sent in full to every downstream widget. For example, if the current widget has 100 data records and there are two downstream widgets, each downstream widget receives all 100 records.

true—data from the current widget is sent alternately to all downstream widgets. For example, if the current widget has 100 data records and two downstream widgets, each downstream widget receives 50 records. The default value is true.  
false—data from the current widget is fully replicated to all downstream widgets. For example, if the current widget has 100 data records and two downstream widgets, each downstream widget receives all 100 records.
